evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline.

observations.why: Flat declarative announcement of a decision already made, delivered without hedge or invitation — the stance of one positioned to declare it.
Bare cited benefits offered as evidence/reasons for the switch, argument-from-facts form.
Formatted as an official record entry (bolded label plus arrow), performing the decision as ratified record rather than argued case.
